patches.description: Kizu Twitch enhancements for Twitch 31.3.1. v2.1 adds Hide Stream Extensions, third-party emote tap-to-preview, Danmaku comments, and a fast horizontal autocomplete strip for Twitch-native/7TV/BTTV/FFZ emotes.
